reviews.title: Average App poor customer service.
reviews.text: You can check my profile. This is probably the second review that I’ve ever written for an app, and I have been an Apple user for well since the first iPhone came out. I’m very frustrated with this app and this developer. I purchased it to track my Topps Disney Chrome card collection, as well as a couple other brands. It advertised itself as having its database that it would scan cards and bring them forward in addition to the AI feature, which has a limited use. There’s a pro feature that cost $79.99, and there’s also the database feature where you can use preloaded information about your cards. Both at the same price, and both have very similar overlapping benefits. When I purchased them, personally, I do not think it’s unreasonable to think that they were the same service. So after I purchased the pro, I went into the app and since it was the same price and some of the features weren’t working, I thought that it just hadn’t been processed, and so I billed again immediately. Once I got the notification that two bills have been taken.  I initially thought I had to spin double billed.  Once I saw that they actually were different, I immediately, same day, requested a refund of one because I explained the confusion and then I would not pay $160 to use this type of app. My requests were denied. And so now I am stuck with an app that doesn’t work well for me. I’ve had to take my own pictures and had very limited use for the database and half of the cards from 2025 weren’t even e

reviews.title: Handy but extortionately expensive
reviews.text:
It’s all in the title. You can track 30 items for “free” just enough to be annoying. The cost is “reduced” to $100 for unlimited collections or $50 for one collection for life. That seems like it’d be it right? Already too much for a fancy excel sheet, but hey- gotta wring a dime out of every single pore of a person, am I right? Because once you decide to buy a “lifetime unlimited” subscription to this stupid app, you’ll be prompted to sign up for the $180 pro plan…

Get out of my pocket, vultures!

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Limited to 30 titles unless you pay $100 or $50/yr to unlock the full edition. That's robbery. Get real.

reviews.title: Stick to the Basics
reviews.text:
It’s fine but over priced for what it is and what features it includes (even with the $100 unlocked version).

The good: Functions very well, organization is relatively good but could be better, all the info that’s pulled up via the barcode as expected, no ads, offers a lifetime option instead of subscription

The bad: AI “functionality”, I was subscribed to a newsletter after purchase, not super user friendly (it appears continuous scanning is not a function - which is crazy for an app like this one), there’s a whole other version for desktop that you apparently also need to buy.

I regret my $100 purchase. Just use sheets or excel.

reviews.title: Insane
reviews.text:
I sincerely want to know what the devs are on. You get about ~15 things to track per category, and then you cannot contribute unless you buy the unlimited option. Okay, then. Crazy as it is, but what could the unlimited option cost? $10, maybe? $5 a month?

No. 100 dollars. I wish I had the audacity.

reviews.title: $100 one time fee. And they don't tell you that until later.
reviews.text:
I was really excited about this app!! There's a search feature found in your collections, so that you don't have to scroll through all of your entries, and it has a super simple layout!
But. I was 30 entries in, grinding out an hour of entering all of my DVD's, and then a pop-up hits me. Before i can continue adding anything else to the collection, it tells me that i have to pay a one time fee of $99 :( kinda nice that it's not annual, but dang bruh i was already 30 entries in. It's a no for me, a paycheck-to-paycheck 20 year old who just wanted to log her prized DVD collection.

reviews.title: Buggy book catalog
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years to catalog a few collections and for the most part it’s great. Recently the books are saving the wrong images (sometimes other fields) when I switch between items and it is increasingly frustrating to correct. Sometimes I have to completely delete the book just to reset it in my collection. Please fix this issue

reviews.title: Super Overpriced
reviews.text: I originally really liked the layout of the app and the functionality of it but, as someone who collects comics, having a 30 item limit is extremely limiting. So against my better judgement I spent the 100 dollars for premium and for a bit I did find everything was worth it until I tried to switch to my laptop to properly edit some of the comics I put on the list. Not only do they want you to spent 100 dollars for a lifetime but they want even more money to use it on your laptop. I find it ridiculous that I have to spend even more after spending such a large sum. For 100 dollars I better be able to use every feature imaginable.

reviews.title: Nice idea, poor execution
reviews.text: Attractive user interface and simple data entry by scanning ISBN or other barcode. Now expensive at £80 annual sub. Let down by bugs and missing features. Worst annoyances: app mixing up data of the last item edited with the current one, spoiling both; no simple way to move items between collections (e.g. books and maps), no way to save an item without a cover image. After using this for 6 months I'm moving on elsewhere.

reviews.title: Deceiving

But recently, it’s been frustrating even adding new books to the app. Even when I use the “scan barcode” option to manually enter it, the titles and images are still not completely accurate. I’m assuming this is due to further addition of AI features. This app did not need AI to begin with. I’m highly considering switching my collection tracking to another app. Screw genAI.

reviews.title: It’s cool. Until…
reviews.text:
You know what’s funny? I was excited to find this app. I collect so many things. I start playing around, it’s lagging and dated, there’s a lot of basic features that could be added to make it more user friendly but I’m just glad it exists. I start logging and eventually I hit a paywall. That’s no problem, I expect that. So you can pay $49 to keep going with your one collection or pay $79 ? To get unlimited in all. Well that’s a no brainier. I opt for that one, everything’s great. And I get more spots for pictures! 
I log in today, and now it’s only letting me add 4 photos. What? I look back at my previous additions, the extra photos are gone. It’s frustrating to lose this, but now I’m being hit with another paywall for “pro”. I’d like to have that back, so I look. $80? For a YEAR? Is it to pay for your crack addition because that’s the only explanation that makes sense to me. You have to be smoking crack if you think this app is worth two $80 investments within a month, and $80 every year until you decide you’re over it and we all lose the data because you stop paying for us to have access. 

And you’re saying $80 is the half off price… soon to be $160 for a year… Ridiculous. Truly.

reviews.title: 9.7.8 update ruins the app
reviews.text:
Updated the app and now it’s either so slow I get bored waiting for it to show me my stuff — or it never loads at all.

Also, it’s apparent the devs want to squeeze every last dime out of you, even after you upgrade your account. I can only store 4 images now, if I want more I have to upgrade yet again.

I used to really love this app but the writing is on the wall. It’s not enough to make a good app that sells itself, instead you have to deal with devs that want you to pay a subscription indefinitely. Avoid this app & find a less greedy dev.

This spoils what is otherwise a great app. I will be looking for an alternative, as I’ve never paid for an app before that still pesters me with constant ads.

I couldn’t even pull up anything resembling something simple as a MAD magazine. By what should’ve taken five minutes, turned into an hour trying to figure this dumb thing out, but I entered it manually, scanned used to light turned off the light everything possible and nothing would work correctly. Finally, I realized it was gonna take about a half hour to enter each thing manually. I might as well write it down with my feet. Again avoid this site. It’s horrendous. It’s terrible. I’ve never ever seen anything so pathetic and you would think apps had just been invented yesterday and that it was just struggling, but wow, did they get this one wrong. You’re a fool if you try it.
